rongmei.title: Amuh nun sa kanmei Guang Messiah

lines: 1. Amuh nun sa kanmei Guang Messsiah,
Keisaria khou gaipui tingmik tang the;
Guan than gaimei tihei (thuan no) (2),
Kau thanmei nun le bumang thanmei,
Duthang rui guang ntak mei nun,
Kau ganchuang le thanmei nun rui,
Neilana Guang than puanmei din lou e.
2. Guang guaina puanmei kum puanpat lou the,
Bethlehem guai kai khou 3)_ puan lou the;
Guang Immanuel ta (thuan no) (2),
Bumang thanmei le laujiu gangmei,
Du thang rui guang ntak mei nun,
Kau banchuang le thanmei nun rui,
Neilana Guang than puanmei din lou e.
3. Kanlou mei Guang Jubili kang khuan 3)_,
Kandih le tingkau ram kagang lik diu;
Guang than gaimei tihei (thuan no) (2),
Bumang thanmei le laujiu gangmei,
Nakmei guang kariu mei 3)_,
Kau banchuang le thanmei nun rui,
Ganphiu rui Guang than puanmei dinlou e.
